table.name: cresset_template_shadow
table.comment: Template engine Shadow comparisons and Parser renders, per store view and template

column.name: store_id
column.comment: Store view the render was for

column.name: template
column.comment: email:ID, email:ID/subject, newsletter:ID, cms_block:ID, cms_page:ID or unidentified:FILTER_CLASS

column.name: agreed
column.comment: Renders where both engines produced the same output

column.name: refused
column.comment: Renders the new engine declined; Parser mode falls back to legacy for these

column.name: crashed
column.comment: Renders where the new engine raised anything else

column.name: served
column.comment: Parser mode: renders served by the new engine

column.name: fell_back
column.comment: Parser mode: renders handed to legacy because the new engine declined

column.name: last_divergence_at
column.comment: Latest divergence or crash, UTC; null if there has been none

column.name: renders_since_divergence
column.comment: Agreements and refusals since last_divergence_at, or since first_seen

column.name: last_divergence
column.comment: JSON: lengths, first differing byte, policy violations, legacy incompatibilities

column.name: last_refusal
column.comment: JSON: the error, problem, line and column

column.name: last_crash
column.comment: JSON: the error class and message
